{"choices": ["Crush a spirit stone for qi", "Crawl to the cave mouth", "Press the wound and wait", "Burn the smoke talisman"], "memory": [{"about": "wei_lan", "note": "Wei Lan betrayed and robbed the player, leaving them to bleed out; she seeks Beast-Butcher Gate entry."}, {"about": "player", "note": "The player is critically wounded (HP 9/60) and lost saber, boar core, and both qi pills."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Say nothing and walk out of the village", "Kneel and dig graves for the Fang family", "Give your spirit stones and boar core to the survivors", "Ask the old man where the wolves came from"], "memory": [{"about": "fang_xiaoyu", "note": "Nine-year-old daughter of the Fang family, killed by ash wolves holding a kitchen knife; the Fang family sheltered the player for a week."}, {"about": "qm-shiyan-guo", "note": "A sinkhole village in the Kingdom of Stone Eyes lost five households to an ash wolf pack of twelve; survivors blame the player for not being enough."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Follow the escort to the wall", "Go inside and face your mother", "Ask the village who else was taken", "Leave tonight for the Night Bridge"], "memory": [{"about": "gongsun_ye", "note": "Captain Gongsun Ye took the three spirit stones as a 'processing fee' and conscripted Ah Jun anyway."}, {"about": "ah_jun", "note": "Ah Jun turned sixteen and was assigned to the Wall of Piled Bones; he left with his jaw set, unbroken."}, {"about": "qm-duigu-qiang", "note": "Ah Jun was sent to the Wall of Piled Bones, where the empire garrisons conscripted boys."}, {"about": "qm-anbian-fu", "note": "The March's garrison takes village boys as quota for the wall; bribes do not buy exemptions."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Get up and walk it off", "Pound on the office door and demand the core back", "Watch the office's back door for Qian leaving", "Ask around the alley for who else got robbed"], "memory": [{"about": "clerk_qian", "note": "Clerk Qian skims by grading cores down and pocketing the difference, with two layer-5 guards to beat complainers."}, {"about": "qm-shoukou-cheng", "note": "The City of the Guarded Mouth's bounty office pays for beast cores brought in from the strait."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Slip out of the crowd before guards move", "Stand and argue your innocence to Bao", "Cut Old Shen's body down yourself", "Ask the crowd who else bought bones"], "memory": [{"about": "old_shen", "note": "Old Shen named you as his buyer to save himself and was hanged anyway at the bone wall."}, {"about": "sergeant_bao", "note": "Sergeant Bao hanged Old Shen to make an example and entered your name in the garrison book as a bone-thief accomplice."}, {"about": "qm-anbian-fu", "note": "You are now wanted in the March of Pacified Borders for bone theft."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Work the cord against the old man's brand", "Whisper to the woman beside you", "Listen at the hatch for Liang's plans", "Test your locked qi quietly in the dark"], "memory": [{"about": "steward_liang", "note": "Liang is Lady Gongsun Wei's steward at Foundation Establishment; he pinned the player with aura and had them stripped and pressed into Night Bridge cargo."}, {"about": "qm-shoukou-cheng", "note": "Night Bridge smugglers load captives under Gongsun banners in a cove south of the Guarded Mouth, rowing out on the turning tide toward Shared Roost City."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Limp to the watchtower and report the python", "Rest here and set a watch on the pillars", "Bind your wounds before moving", "Circle back into the forest for the herbs"], "memory": [{"about": "guide_mao", "note": "Guide Mao took the player's rations, water, and two spirit stones, abandoning them inside the Soul-Lost Stone Forest."}, {"about": "qm-mihun-shilin", "note": "The great python walked the player's circles for three days and let them leave; it now has their scent."}, {"about": "qm-mihun-shilin", "note": "The stone forest's illusions turned the player around; they exited where they entered after three days."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Check Tie Niu's body for anything to return", "Meet the shouting herder coming up the hill", "Leave the ranch before you're blamed", "Sit and steady your qi before anything else"], "memory": [{"about": "court_agent", "note": "A yellow-eyed Beast Court agent at Nascent Soul killed Tie Niu to break his bond and took the thunder-horned fawn; she spared you without a word."}, {"about": "tie_niu", "note": "Tie Niu, eight, bonded a thunder-horned fawn a month ago; the agent killed him and the bond broke."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Strip barnacles and climb the karst pinnacle", "Scream at Ma Ermei's raft for redress", "Search the reef shallows for your pack", "Swim for the nearest island before tide"], "memory": [{"about": "ma_ermei", "note": "Night Bridge crew boss Ma Ermei, layer 7, cut the player's rope to save her cargo and left them drowning on the reef road."}, {"about": "ma_ermei", "note": "Ma Ermei's crew poled away toward the next island with the saved cargo crate; she owes the player nothing in her eyes."}, {"about": "qm-bianhuang", "note": "The tide on the reef road came in an hour early, stranding the player mid-crossing with the shelf flooding within twenty minutes."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Crawl out of the market with what dignity is left", "Hock the boar core to a stall-keeper for stones", "Drag yourself to Lu Pi's table and bargain", "Sit against a stall and take a qi pill"], "memory": [{"about": "lu_pi", "note": "Gang boss Lu Pi, Qi Condensation layer 7, runs the market quarter and broke the player's leg for refusing tribute."}, {"about": "lu_pi", "note": "The player owes Lu Pi ten low-grade stones within one month or he takes the leg."}, {"about": "qm-shoukou-cheng", "note": "In the City of the Guarded Mouth's market, stall-keepers watched the beating and none intervened."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Cut the core out of the boar", "Ask about Xiao Pang's body", "Climb out of the pit and wait", "Wipe your saber and say nothing"], "memory": [{"about": "deacon_hou", "note": "Deacon Hou passed the player in the Beast-Butcher Gate trial and called it 'passable'; he values only the hard."}, {"about": "xiao_pang", "note": "Xiao Pang, a thirteen-year-old orphan partner, was gutted by the trial boar and died in the pit; his body was dragged out by the ankles."}, {"about": "player", "note": "The player killed the iron-hide boar with a saber through the eye and now carries the beast_butcher_candidate flag."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Walk quiet and mark the route", "Test the ropes at the first bend", "Call out to your aunt at the rim", "Curse your uncle's name loudly"], "memory": [{"about": "uncle_bai", "note": "Bai Lao sold the player's hiding place to garrison soldiers for two low-grade stones."}, {"about": "qm-shiyan-guo", "note": "The Stone Eyes council clans' garrison executes conscription writs for the March of Pacified Borders."}, {"about": "player", "note": "Bound and marched toward the cadet school at the City of the Guarded Mouth; pack and saber carried by soldiers."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Break down the inn's barred door", "Circle the inn and watch for movement", "Drag yourself to the road and flag help", "Search the ditch and stable for anything dropped"], "memory": [{"about": "innkeeper_gou", "note": "Innkeeper Gou and his son drugged the player's wine with soul-dulling powder and robbed them of everything at the coast-road waystation."}, {"about": "innkeeper_gou", "note": "The inn is shuttered and barred with a harnessed cart in the yard, suggesting the Gous may be loading to flee."}, {"about": "innkeeper_gou", "note": "The player's stolen goods: frontier saber, iron-hide boar core, 3 low-grade spirit stones, 2 qi pills, bronze mirror."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Sleep. {"choices": ["Flee north toward the island chain", "Return home and keep silent", "Seek out the garrison first", "Spend a stone on qi pills and run"], "memory": [{"about": "factor_yao", "note": "Factor Yao of the Night Bridge Society used the player to poison a march village's well with Gu eggs, killing forty-one, and paid five stones to close the favor."}, {"about": "gu_village_on_your_hands", "note": "The March's garrison will investigate the dead village within the week; the player was seen carrying the crate in and is a face from the March."}, {"about": "factor_yao", "note": "Yao told the player to stay away from the Society's doors for a while."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Follow Gongsun Ye and ask for a place", "Search the ashes for anything of value", "Report to the garrison for your pay", "Slip away before anyone asks more of you"], "memory": [{"about": "gongsun_ye", "note": "Captain Gongsun Ye noted you as reliable after the village burning and flagged you (reliable_to_gongsun_ye)."}, {"about": "march_village", "note": "A march village was burned with thirty-odd survivors inside on Gongsun Ye's order over claimed blood-rot; a woman with a child was turned back at the cordon."}], "names": []}

{"choices": ["Swallow it and walk out the gate", "Demand the manual back", "Draw the saber and strike", "Ask to work off the debt instead"], "memory": [{"about": "elder_mo", "note": "Elder Mo, Foundation Establishment, robbed the player of the Blood-Vein Lotus and the Ember Palm manual and slapped them for asking payment."}, {"about": "elder_mo", "note": "Elder Mo hires young cultivators and pays in beatings; he walks his victims to the gate personally."}], "names": []}
